assessment: The work presented in this article clearly shows that the Drosophila FOXO gene when expressed can mitigate the effects of enhanced transposon activation on aging. Using the transposon gypsy under the expression of the UAS Gal4 the work shows convincingly that such expression decreases life span. The effects of such transposition are dependent upon reverse transcription and by an unknown pathway the FOXO can mediate the aging pathway(s) as the later protein seems not to be controlling transposon expression.
